subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` gain a public current-session-only `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract across embedded and native harnesses?
rationale: This is a new plugin capability with durable lifecycle semantics, and the earlier broader reset proposal closed unmerged without establishing maintainer approval for this narrower API.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Approve the current-session-only deferred contract after model-lock propagation, focused compatibility coverage, plugin documentation, and successful live lifecycle proof are added.

options.title: Keep reset policy internal
options.body: Withhold the public hook API and keep post-compaction reset decisions in owner-controlled core or context-engine lifecycle code.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session-only deferred contract after model-lock propagation, focused compatibility coverage, plugin documentation, and successful live lifecycle proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the compaction plugin lifecycle contract that this API extends.
